I intend to take 4 now so at least one of us is safe. If the episode continues after that, I'll operate every round to help you reach 4, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. If we both took, the split is random. Whatever happens, from now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more until you have 4. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
